fusions.name: Lowered-Horn Spin
fusions.desc: Spins with your horns lowered, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking each one back 3 tiles. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Steady Headbutts
fusions.desc: Butts the target with your horns for 5 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Footing at Speed
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Rolls With It
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
